title: Chapter 1611 - 676: Where Is My Medicinal Power?! (2)
content:
Chapter 1611: Chapter 676: Where Is My Medicinal Power?! (2)

Just then, the voice of Tie Kuang came from above the field.

"Ning Zhuo, my young friend, wake up and stop lazing around. If you can, come out quickly, as the Nanming Fire Furnace is waiting to be repaired!"

Ning Zhuo’s thoughts were interrupted.

Tie Kuang’s voice continued: "There’s another matter. An envoy from Chun Yangzi has arrived, seeking to reclaim the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill."

Ning Zhuo’s heart skipped a beat.

He reached out, taking the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill from his bosom.

The elixir pill remained unassuming.

Ordinary, like a spherical stone.

But as Ning Zhuo held it, he knew clearly in his heart: This Inheritance Pill was now an empty shell. Its medicinal power was nearly gone, leaving only an empty pill shell!

Although the Myriad Phenomena Cradle was merely a spell for the mid-stage level, its current effect was truly formidable—through it, Ning Zhuo had directly absorbed all the true intent from the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill.

Looking at the pill shell, a trace of embarrassment finally appeared on Ning Zhuo’s face.

"Chun Yangzi, upon seeing this situation, might go mad, wouldn’t he?"

He gently coughed.

Even with Ning Zhuo’s thick-skinned nature, he felt a bit embarrassed at this moment.

His initial plan was to absorb as much medicinal power as possible, extracting the true intent.

According to his estimation, the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill contained the insights of the sect leaders through the ages, with true intent as vast as the ocean and ample medicinal power. Even if he exerted all his effort, he could only absorb a part of it.

The remaining medicinal power would definitely be sufficient for returning with an acceptable explanation.

Unexpectedly, midway, he encountered an obstacle, with a knowledge curse looming ahead, forcing Ning Zhuo to find another path. The Myriad Phenomena Cradle was successfully executed, the infant opened its mouth, the world fed him, and the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill was sucked dry, leaving only the pill shell.

Ning Zhuo stared at the pill shell for a few breaths, and the trace of embarrassment slowly faded from his face.

"No, it won’t."

"Chun Yangzi has recently won, and he is still injured, he won’t immediately burst out in anger."

"Besides, even if it becomes a stir, I have a legitimate reason."

The Three Brave of Xiang Sect.

These four words lit up in Ning Zhuo’s mind.

The righteous path name he had meticulously managed and built was indeed useful!

The True Words Bell had already validated his intention.

His desire to rescue the Red Robe Guest’s demon soul was real; his intention to confront the Three Braves of Xiang Sect was also true. The Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill was borrowed for this battle, and absorbing its medicinal power was for quick cultivation, facing formidable foes.

The explanation was acceptable to the world.

If Chun Yangzi wanted to act out, he must first consider whether he could overcome this layer of righteous path principle.

The difficulty was extremely high here!

Ning Zhuo carefully put away the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill, his expression calm.

"Chun Yangzi has won, his prestige significantly increased, which was one of the possibilities I speculated before."

"According to his righteous path accomplishments, the next step would be dealing with me, eliminating internal obstacles."

In the entire Nanming Village, judging by the current members’ performance—politically matched opponents were only Ning Zhuo and Chun Yangzi.

Power cannot be divided. Even if temporarily divided, it inevitably tends towards unification.

Ning Zhuo, who personally built the Nanming Village, linked debts, and swayed various forces, was at the core.

Chun Yangzi’s recent victory over Liang Ming, capturing the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar, was recognized as having the greatest combat strength, paying the highest price, and his prestige skyrocketed.

Two tigers cannot share one mountain!

"Luckily, I have prepared for this situation for a long time."

After thinking for a while, Ning Zhuo began writing letters.

He first sent a letter to the Confucian Cultivator Group.

In the letter, he asked Duanmu Zhang, Chu Xuangu, Dong Nishang, and other Confucian cultivator seniors to assist in the mass production of Inheriting Dao Jade Pages. The costs and favors owed would surely be repaid by Ning Zhuo in the future.

Next, he wrote to Sun Lingtong, Chef, Gongsun Yan, and others, explaining his condition and arranging the following affairs.

The letter to Chen San was even more detailed.

He continued to repay assistance, continued to apologize, continued to register favors. For those unwilling to accept returns, he documented names, origins, assisted items, and requested matters. No negligence or embezzlement was allowed. The Three Brave Life-taking Nail remained excluded from the repayment list.

Then, he sent letters to Shen Xi, Situ Xing, Lin Jinglong, and others.

The gist was: All friends’ kindness is remembered by Ning Zhuo. Having recently completed the Xingyun Trial, he missed the appointment, and felt ashamed in his heart. Fortunately, the Nanming Village has secured the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar, hearing the echo of your prior investment. Next, Ning Zhuo will join Senior Tie Kuang in repairing the Nanming Fire Furnace, not returning to the village for the time being.

Finally, he wrote a letter to Chun Yangzi.

Dear Senior Chun Yangzi, personally opened. Ning Zhuo is deeply grateful for the favor of the Pure Yang Ancestor Master Pill. This junior has greatly benefited from comprehending Yang Dao, Alchemy Dao, and Fire-attribute cultivation, all thanks to your completion. The pill’s true intent is heavily depleted now, and the junior feels ashamed, willing to make up to Pure Yang Peak with the medicinal benefits after the restoration of the Nanming Fire Furnace.

"Senior has newly triumphed, bearing severe injuries, should prioritize recovery. The Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar is newly established; please preside over the big picture. Ning Zhuo will temporarily follow Senior Tie Kuang to repair the Nanming Fire Furnace, and after the furnace is completed, will personally plead guilty to you."

Ning Zhuo bowed his head, giving Chun Yangzi all the face he could, and wove the restoration of the Nanming Fire Furnace, the battle with the Three Braves of Xiang Sect, and the big picture of the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar all into the letter.

Chun Yangzi would be angry.

But Chun Yangzi would also endure.

The Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar.

Chun Yangzi sat in the hall.

A middle-aged cultivator was standing below the hall.

This person was tall and slim, with slightly ruddy skin, thick black eyebrows, dressed in a distinctly worn reddish-brown vestment robe, with a copper gourd hanging at his waist, occasionally emitting a warm white light dust from the gourd’s mouth.

His name was Zhao Wangyang, hailing from Chaohui Temple, practicing the Lesser Yang Breathing Technique, with Golden Core Middle Stage cultivation, best at warming injuries with Yang Energy, and dispelling cold darkness.

Zhao Wangyang held out a document with both hands as a token of allegiance.
